facts.raw_span: A 57-year-old asymptomatic man
history of stage IIIc localized prostate cancer
completed a course of prostate-directed radiation therapy with a SpaceOAR hydrogel spacer
mild straining with bowel movements and occasional passage of mucus
large deep-cratered solitary ulcer on the anterior rectal wall with firm margins, friability, and exudate
remainder of the rectum appeared normal
spacer positioned between the prostate and rectum
Biopsies of the lesion were negative for malignancy
